The '''Planetary Defense Cannon''' was a heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] built by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]]. It bore an uncanny resemblance to the [[W-165 planetary turbolaser]] and there were accusations of corporate espionage. Regardless it used four times as much energy as the W-165 and was capable of completely obliterating an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]]. It required a crew of 46 to operate but could get by with a skeleton crew of 21.<ref name="HS" />
